headline: PROBE 🕵️ BEGINS 🔎 Into Amazon ✈️ Cargo Plane 🛫 OVERRAN 🏃‍♂️ Miami 🛬 Runway 💥
text:
OFFICIALS 🧑‍⚖️ are now DEEP 🕳️ into the PROBE 🧪 trying to figure 🧠 out exactly 🤔 why that Amazon 📦 cargo ✈️ plane just YEETED 🏌️ itself right off 🛫 the Miami 🏖️ runway 🛬 and turned 💥 the whole scene into a nightmare 😱 on Sunday ☀️!! The Boeing 🛩️ 767-300 operated ✈️ by 21 Air slammed 🚗 across a road 🛣️ beyond the end 🛑 and smashed 🥊 several vehicles 🚙 on the ground 🌍 killing 🪦 five people 🧍 and seriously injuring 🤕 five more in this DEADLY 💀 crash just before 2pm 🕒!! NTSB 🕵️‍♂️ investigators are already on site 🏗️ and will brief 📢 reporters 🗣️ on Monday afternoon ☕ while 21 Air 🛫 out of North Carolina 🗺️ says they are straight up DEVASTATED 😭 by the accident involving one of their birds 🐦 and both they and Amazon 📦 are fully COOPERATING 🤝 with the probe 🧪!! "At least five people have lost their lives 🪦 and five others are injured 🤕" said Miami-Dade 🏙️ Mayor Daniella Levine Cava at the news conference 📰 while rescue crews 🚒 rolled up in literal SECONDS ⏱️ to start prying 🛠️ folks out from under crushed cars 🚗!!

THREE 🕒 of the injured 🩹 were in critical 🚨 condition according to Miami Fire Chief Raied Jadallah 🧯 who confirmed several victims were trapped 🪢 inside or under vehicles 🚙 and had to be cut 🪚 out by fire and rescue teams after the plane BURST 🔥 into flames 🔥 with over TWO HUNDRED 🚒 firefighters swarming 🐝 the scene like it was the end of the world 🌎!! Experts 🧠 chatting with AP 📡 say the video footage 🎥 will have investigators questioning whether the Amazon ✈️ jet even touched down 🛬 in its designated touchdown zone 🟥 or if something went horribly wrong 🤦 right after and what exactly caused that overshoot 🏃‍♂️ at 112 knots 🌀 as it left the usable runway 🛣️!! The whole airport ✈️ got shut down 🔒 by the FAA 🛑 right in the middle of Labor Day weekend 🏖️ which is one of the busiest travel times of the year 🧳 and passengers 🧳 were left stranded 😤 with long lines 🕒 at counters trying to rebook flights 🛫 while some poor souls had to book hotels 🏨 for an extra night in Miami 🌴!!

LOCALS 👥 like Grace Mercado told CBS 📺 she was in a vehicle 🚗 nearby when she saw the aftermath 🌫️ and said "The plane was up in smoke 💨 it was just like something from a movie 🎥 it was crazy 🤪" while Beth Tilman described a thick black cloud ☁️ and an acrid stench 🦨 that wasn't trees 🌳 or mangroves 🪴 but some other odour she had never smelled before in her life 👃!! FlightRadar24 📡 data shows the cargo flight was hauling 🍑 at 112 knots 🌀 when it exited the usable runway 🛬 and came to rest near a car park 🅿️ that serves an Amazon warehouse 📦 and other businesses 🏬 with light thunderstorms ⛈️ and gusting winds 🌬️ in the air at the time of the incident 🕒!! Amazon's Kelly Nantel said "We're heartbroken 💔 to learn that five people lost their lives 🪦 in today's incident at Miami International Airport 🏬 our deepest sympathies go out to the families" while confirming the plane operated by 21 Air was attempting to land 🛬 when everything went sideways 😵 and they are working closely with authorities 👮 to learn more!!

21 AIR'S 🛫 CEO Keith Winters dropped a statement 📝 offering "Our deepest condolences 🙏 are with the families and loved ones of those who lost their lives 🪦 our immediate priorities are supporting those affected assisting the authorities and ensuring that accurate information is communicated" as the plane had earlier departed ✈️ from Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport in San Juan Puerto Rico 🇵🇷 before this tragedy struck 🥊 during one of the busiest travel weekends of the year in the US 🦅!! Passengers 🧳 at the airport were straight up FRUSTRATED 😤 by the lack of information coming from officials with many flights cancelled ✈️ or delayed ⏳ as a direct result of the incident causing long queues 🕒 at airline counters and some saying they would be forced to stay in Miami 🌴 an extra night because the earliest flight they could find was Tuesday morning 🌅!! The TSA 🛂 predicted a whopping 2.3 million people would fly ✈️ on Sunday alone with 17 million travellers passing through US airports in the week leading up to Labor Day and Miami International Airport 🏙️ being one of the busiest in the country for international freight 📦 and passengers 👥 offering more flights to Latin America and the Caribbean than anywhere else!!

THE CRASH 💥 itself has everyone down bad 😞 with Mayor Daniella Levine Cava calling it an "incredibly difficult day" after five confirmed dead 🪦 and locals describing the smoke 💨 and stench 🦨 like it was straight out of a disaster film 🎞️ while rescue crews 🛟 worked overtime to extricate trapped victims from mangled vehicles 🚗 that got hit when the Boeing 🛩️ overran the runway 🛣️ at Miami International 🏖️!! Investigators 🕵️ are laser focused on whether the plane touched down 🛬 in the right zone and what exactly happened next with the gusting winds 🌬️ and thunderstorms ⛈️ possibly playing a role as the flight data 📊 clearly shows it was still hauling serious speed 🏎️ when it left the usable pavement 🛑 and plowed 🚜 into that road and those cars causing the fatalities 🪦 and critical injuries 🚨 that have left the whole city reeling 🤕!!
